A '''village''' on the world of [[Cerea/Legends|Cerea]] served as the home of the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and his family. It was here that Jedi Master [[The Dark Woman|An'ya Kuro]] came and found the four year old Mundi in [[88 BBY/Legends|88 BBY]].<ref name="Comic" />

As a result of the encounter and at the behest of Mundi's father, Kuro took Mundi to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for training. This village was presumably destroyed in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] when Mundi's family was killed during the [[Battle of Cerea|battle]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="Comic" />
